s: Dine simchat yom tob ubo y"g seipim: keshem shemmitzva lekabbed et hashshabbat uleannegah — kak kol yamim tobim, shenneemar "liqdosh Hashem mekubbad", vekol yamim tobim neemar bahen "miqra qodesh".

Ezeh kabod? Zeh sheameru chakamim shemmitzva al haadam legalleach beereb yom tob, kede shello yikkanes laregel keshehu menuvval. Veken mitzva lirchotz bechammin velachop rosho velittol tzippornayv beereb yom tob kemo beereb shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"s. Veken mitzva lalush pat bebeto beereb yom tob likbod yom tob kemo beereb shabbat likbod shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"b ayyen sham. Veken mitzva lehimmana milliqboa seudda beereb yom tob mishshaa asirit ulemala kede sheyyokal seuddat yom tob leteabon, shezzehu mikkelal hakkabod. Veim ereb yom tob hu shabbat shetztzarik leekol seudda shelishit — yoklenna qodem shaa asirit. Veim shakach o abar velo akalah qodem shaa asirit — yoklenna achar kak. Veken haddin beyom tob rishon shehu ereb yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, o shel rosh hashshana apillu beeretz yisrael.
Ezeh oneg? Zeh sheameru chakamim shechayyab adam leekol bekol yom tob b' seuddot, achat ballayla veachat bayyom beshacharit. Abal en tzarik leekol seudda shelishit, ella im ken chal beshabbat.

Veiqqar hasseudda hu hallechem asher hu okel, lepikak tzarik lehizzaher sheyyokal bekol seudda pat yoter mikkebetza meat, shead kebetza niqra akilat aray. Vetzarik liqboa kol seudda al hayyayin, dehaynu sheyyishteh yayin beemtza seuddato im yado masseget. Veyarbeh bebasar veyayin umigdanot kepi yekolto, veal yetzamtzem behotzaat yom tob, shekkol mezonotayv vitziotayv shel adam qetzubim lo merosh hashshana, chutz mehotzaot shabbatot veyamim tobim, sheim pichet — pochatin lo, veim hosip — mosipin lo, veayyen besimman rm"b.

B' mitzvot ellu shehen kabod veoneg, hen nohagot gam ken berosh hashshana, shehare neemar bo "miqra qodesh". Abal enan nohagot bechullo shel moed, shehare lo neemar bahen "miqra qodesh". Ukebar nitbaer besimman rm"b shehakkabod vehaoneg hen mitzvot middibre soperim umeporashin al yede hannebiim.

Veyesh bechol hammoed mah sheen berosh hashshana, vehu shekkol shibat yeme happesach ushemonat yeme hechag, veken beyom tob shel atzeret — chayyab adam lihyot sameach vetob leb hu ubanayv veishto ubene beto vekol hannilvim elayv, vesimcha zo hi mitzvat aseh min hattora, shenneemar "vesamachta bechaggeka atta ubinka ubitteka vego'".

Ketzad mesammechan? Haqqetannim noten lahem qelayot veegozim, vehannashim qoneh lahem begadim vetakshitin kepi mamono, vehaanashim bizman shebbet hammiqdash haya qayyam hayu okelin besar shelamim lesimcha, veakshav sheen bet hammiqdash qayyam — en yotzeim yede chobat simcha ella beyayin, shenneemar "veyayin yesammach lebab enosh". Abal basar en choba leekol akshav, kevan sheen lanu besar shelamim. Umikkol maqom, mitzva yesh baakilat basar beyom tob, kevan shenneemar bo simcha, vehoil vei epshar lanu lismoach bo beiqqar hassimcha shehi akilat besar shelamim — yesh lanu lesammecho bishar kol mine semachot. Lekak nahagu leharbot bemine maakalim beyom tob yoter mibbeshabbat shello neemar bah simcha, veken bigde yom tob tzerikim lihyot yoter tobim mibbigde shabbat.

Beyom tob shacharit meacharin meat labo lebet hakkeneset, kede sheyyakinu miqtzat tzorke hasseudda qodem halika lebet hakkeneset, velo yitztareku lehitakkeb betiqqun kol tzorke seudda beboam mibbet hakkeneset. Vegam bebet hakkeneset en maarikin meod, ella memaharin latzet kede lismoach besimchat yom tob. Veyesh ligor bachazzanim hammaarikim yoter mechatzot hayyom, kemo shennitbaer besimman rp"ch ayyen sham.

Akshav bizman hazzeh shemmaarikim bepiyyutim vikolot hannashim lehakin tzorke hasseudda beod sheomerim happiyyutim, lepikak yemaharu labo lebet hakkeneset kemo bishar yemot hashshana. Vetzarik limchot beyad miqtzat meqomot shemmeacharim labo lebet hakkeneset beyom tob vegam maarikim bepiyyutim qodem qeriat shema, umittok kak hem oberim zeman qeriat shema.

Ap al pi shehaakila ushetiyya bammoadot hi mitzvat aseh — lo yihyeh okel veshoteh kol hayyom kullo, shehare kebar neemar: "atzeret laHashem eloheka", veap al pi shenneemar: "atzeret tihyeh lakem", kebar pereshu chakamim: chetzyo laHashem vechetzyo lakem. Lepikak, kak hi haddat hannekona: babboqer mashkimin kol haam lebatte kenesiyyot ulebatte midrashot umitpalelin shacharit umusap, vechozerim lebattehem veokelin seuddat habboqer, veholekim lebatte midrashot veqorin bannebiim vedoreshin baaggada ad achar chatzot hayyom, kede leqayyem "chetzyo laHashem", veachar kak mitpalelin mincha, vechozerin lebattehem leekol velishtot velismoach simchat yom tob shear hayyom ad hallayla, kede leqayyem "chetzyo lakem". Veakshav shemmaarikim beniggunim betok hattepilla — en zeh oleh biklal "chetzyo laHashem", ella biklal "lakem" hu.

Ukeshehu okel veshoteh — chayyab lehaakil lagger layyatom velaalmana im shear haaniyyim haumlalim, shenneemar "vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vego'". Abal mi shennoel dalte chatzero veokel veshoteh hu ubanayv veishto veeno maakil umashqeh laaniyyim ulemare nepesh — en zo simchat mitzva ella simchat kereso, veal ellu neemar: "zibchehem kelechem onim lahem, kol okelayv yittammau, ki lachmam lenapsham" tame hu, vesimcha kazo qalon hu lahem, shenneemar "vezeriti peresh al penekem peresh chaggekem".

Kesheadam okel veshoteh vesameach baregel — lo yimshok beyayin ubischoq ubeqallut rosh veyomar kol mi sheyyosip bazeh yarbeh bemitzvat simcha, shehashshikrut vehassechoq harbeh veqallut harosh enah simcha ella holelut vesiklut, velo nitztavvinu al haholelut vehassiklut ella al hassimcha sheyyesh bah abodat yotzer hakkol, shenneemar "tachat asher lo abadta et Hashem eloheka besimcha ubetub lebab merob kol", ha lamadta shehaaboda hi besimcha, vei epshar laabod et Hashem lo mittok sechoq velo mittok shikrut.

Chayyabim bet din lehaamid shoterim baregalim, sheyyihyu mesabbebin umechappesin baggannot upardesim veal hanneharot, shello yitqabbetzu sham anashim venashim leekol velishtot veyabou lide abera. Veken yazhiru zeh lekol haam shello yitarebu anashim venashim bebattehem lesimcha velo yimmasheku bayyayin, shemma yabou lide abera, ella kullam yihyu qedoshim. (Ad hilkot rosh hashshana lo bau bidpus meolam beshulchan aruk hazzeh ki lo nimtzeu bekitbe hamchabber nishmato eden).
